messages:
maria: quick sync 1: thinking about concrete semantics for runtime hedging vs control-plane rollbacks. need a short proposal we can ship as an RFC addendum. main goals: avoid duplicate mitigation, bound cost, and make quarantine decisions auditable.

sylas: agree. my gut: runtime should be allowed short-lived hedges (<200ms extra) and only to variants within the same availability ring. anything wider (variant quarantine or traffic reweight) is orchestrator territory.

raj: how do we encode 'bounded'? config flags per-variant: hedge_window_ms, max_extra_rps, and a global max_hedge_multiplier. runtime enforces locally and increments billing-counter for extra requests.

olivia: +1 on billing counter. also: control-plane should be able to stamp a signed lease when it quarantines a variant so the runtime can trust the decision (prevents rogue operators).

maria: propose these primitives: (1) QuarantineLease { variant_id, state, since, ttl, signer, reason, signature }, (2) ProbeDelta protobuf for compressed metrics, (3) HedgeBudget token for runtime accounting.

sylas: small nit: keep QuarantineLease tiny. Put human-readable reason optional. signature scheme = ed25519 over canonical bytes. runtime verifies quickly.

raj: on metric cadence: compressed protobuf windowed summaries. Default windows: errors=15s, latencies=30s. We also send rare full samples for debugging (1/1000).

olivia: what about SDKs? we should surface a single control-plane websocket/SSE endpoint for leases and weight updates. runtime should open a persistent connection and fall back to polling.

maria: agreed. SSE primary, polling fallback. add backoff & jitter to avoid stampedes. also include a small endpoint for lease reconciliation after reboots.

sylas: drain semantics: when a lease quarantines a variant, runtime marks it DRAINING and stops new allocations for that variant but allows in-flight requests to finish for up to drain_grace_ms (default 30s). we must record variant_token on every request so traces show which variant served it.

raj: variant_token should be opaque + monotonic per-variant instance. Traces: add tags variant_token and lease_id. Also emit a correlated event when an orchestrator revokes a lease.

olivia: operator UX: quarantines should appear in the console with an "acknowledge" button. unack clears lease immediately; otherwise TTL expires and orchestrator auto-evaluates recovery.

maria: recovery rules: orchestrator may auto-clear if probe windows return under threshold for 3 consecutive windows. but we should not auto-reinstate traffic automatically: require staged re-join (small ramp) unless operator explicit.

sylas: multi-arm experiments: orchestrator writes target weights + optional ramp duration + lease. runtime applies smooth ramping (leaky bucket) per host to reach target weight over ramp. add a safety clamp so weight changes never exceed delta_per_second.

raj: races: orchestrator may issue a new lease while runtime still draining old variant. leases have monotonic revision numbers; runtime applies higher revision and transitions cleanly. older leases are ignored.

olivia: telemetry note: probes should carry a compact provenance header: provenance=(host_id, runtime_version, lease_rev). that will make aggregations less noisy.

maria: docs + actionables: (1) sylas drafts QuarantineLease proto + signature spec; (2) raj drafts ProbeDelta proto + window defaults and sampling rates; (3) olivia wires control-plane SSE API + console UX sketch; (4) maria writes SDK trace tags and hedge_budget semantics.

sylas: i'll also add unit tests to assert hedges never exceed budget under synthetic load.

deploy-bot: roll: feature-flag "quarantine-lease-v1" turned on in staging @ 2026-04-02T09:05:00Z :rocket:

maria: nice. i'll collect writeups and ship the addendum early next week. thanks all. :pray:
